انفقعت (form VII)
# اِنْفَقَعْتُ (infaqaʕtu) /in.fa.qaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
# اِنْفَقَعْتَ (infaqaʕta) /in.fa.qaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
# اِنْفَقَعْتِ (infaqaʕti) /in.fa.qaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَقَعَ (infaqaʕa)
# اِنْفَقَعَتْ (infaqaʕat) /in.fa.qa.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
